recognize_zh: 單一顆異常早幼粒細胞的細胞質內含有大量交錯、成束排列的 Auer 小體，並覆蓋在細胞核上，就是急性前骨髓細胞白血病的「柴束細胞」（faggot cell）。
features: Numerous Auer rods arranged in crisscrossing bundles ('faggots')
Rods and granules overlying and partially obscuring the nucleus
Slightly irregular cell outline; image focus limits fine chromatin detail
describe_en: High-power view shows a single abnormal promyelocyte whose cytoplasm is packed with numerous Auer rods arranged in crisscrossing bundles, overlying the nucleus together with dense azurophilic granules. Fine chromatin detail is limited by focus. This cell represents a classic faggot cell, a finding highly suggestive of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent PML::RARA confirmation and coagulation assessment are recommended.

ddx.vs: Non-APL AML typically shows single Auer rods in blasts rather than dense bundles of rods in a heavily granulated promyelocyte.
Normal promyelocytes have round eccentric nuclei with a Golgi hof and coarse granules but never contain Auer rods.
Pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi inclusions are large round granules, not slender rod-shaped bundles.
